title: Martians built the moon as a transport and terraforming device
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Martians built the moon as a transport and terraforming device, about remote prehistory at The Moon, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the people on Mars probably constructed the moon for two purposes.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that people living on Mars long ago probably built Earth's moon for two purposes: as a way to travel and as a tool for making Earth livable. He points to the work of Joe McMoneagle, a man trained to describe distant places using only his mind, and to a document called Closer Encounters. If true, the moon would be a made object rather than a natural one.
